title: Differentiability of Shape Function for Piecewise Smooth Lagrangians in Poissonian Random Environments
summary: We consider a family of models of directed first passage percolation type in continuous multi-dimensional Euclidean space and discrete time with admissible paths constrained to visiting a Poissonian point at each step. We show that even if the Lagrangian defining the cost or energy of a step is allowed to have gradient discontinuities, the resulting shape function, or effective Lagrangian, belongs to the class C1 and provide a formula for its gradient.
